name: R4 Girdle of the Earth Spirit

system.description:
[Trigger: Refer] Use when you receive the effect of a Prop with the [Terrain] tag. That effect is nullified. Once per scene. Footgear crafted by the techniques of the Earth Fairy Nomad. With the blessing of the earth, it allows one to easily traverse unstable ground.

Giant's Beard [Core Material] (50G) + Leather Boots (60G) + Endurance Boots (40G) + [Magic Catalyst 4] (30G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (120G)
